lines.zh: 笨拙地踏着沉重的步伐。
锤子在手中笨拙地挥舞。
盔甲发出咯吱声，缓慢前进。
盯着你，眼中闪烁着野蛮。
摸索着前进，仿佛迷失方向。
挥舞着武器，似乎在找方向。
缓慢地在黑暗中摸索前进。
每走一步都伴随着沉重的呼吸。

lines.en: His boots grind the mine rubble.
His armored coat scrapes the cart rails.

lines.zh: 手持沉重的锤子，等待机会。
紧握武器，随时准备战斗。
低头盯着地面，似乎在思考。
偶尔发出低沉的金属摩擦声。
lines.en: Metal rubs with a low clank.

lines.zh: 握紧双拳，显得更加警惕。

lines.en: He rests, hammer haft on the ground.
He wipes the axe with a rag.
Sweat seeps under the iron helm.
He counts the echoes in the shaft.

lines.zh: 盯着你，似乎在思考对策。
发出威胁的低吼，步步逼近。

lines.en: The eyes under his helm narrow.
He lifts a finger at you.
His breath gusts over rusted plate.
He swings the shield to his front.
He knows you don't belong here.
A grunt rolls out of his throat.
He tries to rise and wobbles.
He turns the hammer in his grip.

lines.zh: 沉重的盔甲让行动变得缓慢。
lines.en: The heavy armor slows me down.

lines.zh: 矮人的怒火已无法驱散伤痛。
lines.en: The dwarf's rage can't drive out the pain.

lines.zh: 盔甲碎片划伤了我的皮肤。
我感觉我的骨头要碎了。

lines.en: I fell and got badly hurt.

lines.zh: 锤子的重量让我难以站立。
lines.en: The hammer's weight makes standing hard.

lines.zh: 我被重击了，几乎失去了意识。
lines.en: I was struck hard, nearly unconscious.

lines.zh: 我的身体被击中了，疼痛难忍。
lines.en: My body was hit, the pain is unbearable.

lines.zh: 我被挤压得喘不过气来。
我被重物砸中，喘不过气。
矮人将军的盔甲闪烁着微光！
它的声音低沉，充满怒火！
lines.en: Its voice is deep and full of anger.

lines.zh: 你注意到它的手镯上刻着符文！
lines.en: You notice runes etched on its bracelet.

lines.zh: 矮人将军的刀锋锐利无比！
它的脚步声沉重，如同石块落地！
lines.en: Its footsteps sound heavy, like falling stones.

lines.zh: 矮人将军的手中握着一束火把！
lines.en: The general holds a bundle of torches.

lines.zh: 它的声音低沉，回荡在洞穴中！
lines.en: Its voice reverberates in the cavern.

lines.zh: 矮人将军的眼睛里燃烧着怒火！
lines.en: Fury burns in the general's eyes.

lines.zh: 它的盔甲上满是战斗的痕迹！
lines.en: Its armor is riddled with battle scars.

lines.zh: 矮人将军挥舞着巨锤，发出震耳欲聋的声音！
lines.en: The general swings his great hammer with thunderous noise.

lines.zh: 矮人将军的盾牌砸向你！
lines.en: The general's shield smashes towards you.
He tries to crush you with his hammer.

lines.zh: 矮人将军的长矛刺了过来！
lines.en: The general's spear comes at you.

lines.zh: 他的刀刃划过你的身体！
lines.en: His blade slices through your body.

lines.zh: 矮人将军用战锤劈向你！
lines.en: The general's warhammer chops at you.

lines.zh: 他撞向你，试图用体重碾压你！
lines.en: He charges at you, trying to crush you with his weight.

lines.zh: 矮人将军的巨锤砸向地面！
lines.en: The general's great hammer smashes into the ground.

lines.zh: 矮人将军用盾牌挡住你的攻击！
lines.en: The general blocks your attack with his shield.

lines.zh: 矮人将军试图用大剑劈开你的防御！
lines.en: The general tries to cleave through your defenses with his greatsword.

lines.zh: 矮人将军挥舞着武器，朝你冲来！
lines.en: The general charges at you, swinging his weapon.

lines.zh: 矮人将军命令他的士兵！
矮人将军的嘶吼充满怒气！
lines.en: The general's roar is filled with anger.

lines.zh: 矮人将军的长枪闪耀着光芒！

lines.en: He commands his soldiers to advance.
He wields his weapon, preparing to fight.

lines.zh: 矮人将军的盔甲上刻有符文！
lines.en: Runes are etched on the general's armor.
He swings his sword at the enemy.

lines.zh: 矮人将军的怒吼震撼着山洞！
lines.en: The general's roar shakes the cavern.

lines.zh: 将军的骨头，捡起来很沉。
lines.en: The general's bones are heavy to pick up.
This ore buys three jugs of stout.

lines.zh: 个子这么高，躲不过我的眼。
lines.en: That tall? You can't hide from my eyes.
The fate of the dwarves is here!
I shall rend thee limb from limb!

lines.zh: 矮人大军已经排好队了。
lines.en: The dwarf ranks are already lined up.
The honor of the dwarves shall not be sullied!

lines.zh: 我要为我的矮人兄弟复仇！
lines.en: I shall avenge my dwarf brothers!
No one else is in this tunnel but you.
First, the hammer takes your knees.
He nods toward where you stand.
The power of the dwarves awakens!

lines.zh: 你将为你的罪行付出代价！
lines.en: Thou shalt pay for thy sins!
The fury of the dwarves shall burst forth!

lines.zh: 矮人的智慧将引导胜利！
lines.en: The wisdom of the dwarves shall guide victory!
The honor of the dwarves shall endure!
The victory of the dwarves is at hand!

lines.zh: 抡起锤子砸向你的影子

lines.en: He closes in on the mine lamp.
The axe blade rises past his helm.
His breathing wheezes like a bellows.
The hammer arcs over your head.
He shuffles around a mine post.
He waits for your step to come closer.

lines.zh: 挥舞笨拙的武器，轰隆作响。
矮小身躯中蕴藏巨大力量。
挥剑砍向敌人，声响惊人。
笨拙中透露着不凡，一击即中。
武器碰撞，发出沉闷的响声。
挥舞锤子，震得地面颤抖。
笨拙的步伐，却步步杀机。
挥动大锤，敌人难以招架。
挥剑如风，敌人无处藏身。

lines.en: The hammer falls and a rail tie snaps.
He rams you with his pauldron.
A heavy boot kicks out at you.
The haft sweeps at your ribs.
He kicks the lamp at your face.

lines.zh: 在废弃矿井中偶尔现身。
在昏暗的矿井底部出现。
在黑暗矿井中偶尔出现。
在矿石深处，等待着猎物。
在矿井深处，悄无声息出现。
矿井深处的灯忽然亮了
lines.en: Deep in the shaft, a lamp flares.
He rises from behind a minecart.

lines.zh: 岩壁的裂缝里挤出人影
lines.en: A shape squeezes out of a rock seam.
The dwarf crawls from a cave-in.

lines.zh: 锈甲在黑暗里响了一声
lines.en: Rusted plate clanks in the dark.
He hauls himself up by a post.
Footsteps come from the old tunnel.
He appears from behind the rubble.

lines.zh: 燃烧的火焰灼烧着我的皮肤。
lines.en: The burning flames scorch my skin.

lines.zh: 坠落的冲击让我无法呼吸。
lines.en: The fall's impact left me gasping.

lines.zh: 水中的窒息让我无法呼吸。
爆炸的碎片穿透了我的盔甲。
lines.en: The explosion's fragments pierced my armor.

lines.zh: 投射物击中了我的盾牌。
魔法的力量撕裂了我的皮肉。
虚空的触碰让我濒死挣扎。
lines.en: The void's touch left me struggling.
